name: python-outbox-pattern
title: Python transactional outbox
blurb: A transactional outbox: the business row and the event commit together, and the consumer is proven to apply duplicates once.
default_description: A transactional outbox over SQLite: the order row and its event commit in one transaction, a crash between publish and mark is proven to cost a duplicate rather than an event, and the consumer applies it once.
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff
